Medium confidence; the name only says 'offset', not the sign.

plate_comment: Name kept. Effective fuel limit with the engine speed limiter: below the speed limit (the ramped torque_limit_fuel_reference with the droop slope in the low word of torque_limit_error_integrator, or lowest_source_speed_limit when the override is inactive or the speed already reached it) the limit is injection_quantity_combustion_maximum_limit; above it, it falls from fuel_demand_torque_table_output by the speed excess x 0x3ae1 / (slope x 8), floored at 0 and capped at protection_fuel_limit_cal_active (a zero slope cuts the fuel at once). The result is then lowered to the other fuel limits and, for the all-speed governor, to the droop fuel demand.
